question.text: What will the PNC 2026 Christmas Price Index (12 Days of Christmas) be in USD?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the total value, in US dollars, of the [PNC Christmas Price Index](https://www.pnc.com/en/about-pnc/topics/pnc-christmas-price-index.html) for 2026.
question.fine_print: Please note that this is the headline number, which is one set of the 12 gifts, not the "True Cost of Christmas in Song" figure totalling 364 presents.

research:
Still no 2026 release, so I'm writing up the background I found.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-11-12: The [PNC Christmas Price Index page](https://www.pnc.com/en/about-pnc/topics/pnc-christmas-price-index.html) still shows **2025: $51,476.12** (up 4.5% from $49,263.47). It gives no 2026 figure.
- 2025 item prices on that page: partridge $420.18; doves $750; hens $346.50; calling birds $599.96; 5 gold rings $1,649.90 (up 32.5%); geese $930; swans $13,125 (flat); maids $58; dancers $8,856.88; lords $16,836.14 (up 8.1%); pipers $3,797.48; drummers $4,106.08. The "Core" index, which leaves out swans, was $38,351.12. [PNC](https://www.pnc.com/en/about-pnc/topics/pnc-christmas-price-index.html)
- The 2025 press release gives the lords as $15,579.65, which doesn't match the page's $16,836.14. I could not work out why. [PNC mediaroom](https://pnc.mediaroom.com/2025-11-24-PNCs-2025-Christmas-Price-Index-R-Holiday-Cheer-Comes-at-a-Premium)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-11-12: Nothing settles the question yet. PNC's newsroom lists releases up to Nov 9, 2026 (stablecoin payments) and none about the Christmas Price Index. [PNC mediaroom](https://pnc.mediaroom.com/news-releases)
- 2025-11-24: Last year's index came out on Nov 24. The 2024 release was dated "Nov." and picked up by media in late November and early December. So the 2026 release probably lands just before or around the ~Dec 1 resolution date, after forecasts close. [PNC mediaroom](https://pnc.mediaroom.com/2025-11-24-PNCs-2025-Christmas-Price-Index-R-Holiday-Cheer-Comes-at-a-Premium), [KNEI](https://kneiradio.com/?p=21116)

## 3. Recent news
- 2026-11-12: Spot gold is about $3,930/oz, down about 5.8% year over year and well below the January 2026 all-time high of about $5,608. This matters for the gold rings line, which jumped 32.5% in 2025. Note the rings are priced at retail (Gordon Jewelers), not at spot. [Trading Economics](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/gold)
- 2026-11-10: October 2026 CPI rose 0.4% month over month, above the 0.3% expected. Core was up 0.3% for a third month. I did not confirm the year-over-year rate. [Nikkei](https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOFL110100R11C26A1000000/)
- 2025-11-24: PNC CIO Amanda Agati said it will be "very interesting to see where the index shakes out in 2026," given looser Fed policy. [Business Journal Daily](https://businessjournaldaily.com/pncs-christmas-price-index-rises-4-5/)
- I found no previews or leaks of 2026 item prices.

## 4. Base rates
Recent values, from [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christmas_Price_Index) and PNC:
- 2019: $38,993.59 (+0.17%)
- 2021: $41,205.58 (+5.7% vs 2019; 2020 was distorted by COVID)
- 2022: $45,523.27 (+10.5%)
- 2023: $46,729.86 (+2.7%)
- 2024: $49,263.47 (+5.4%)
- 2025: $51,476.12 (+4.5%)

Pattern:
- Over 2014-2025 the yearly change ranged from about +0.2% to +11%, ignoring 2020 and the 2015 method changes. Over 2022-2025 it averaged about +5.8%.
- Over 40+ years, falls are rare: 1988, 1995, 2002 and the 2020 COVID year.
- PNC's index has beaten the BLS October CPI recently: 5.4% vs 2.6% in 2024, and 4.5% vs 3.0% in 2025. [Business Journal Daily](https://businessjournaldaily.com/pncs-christmas-price-index-rises-4-5/)
- Swans ($13,125, about 25% of the total) were flat in 2025, so most of the movement comes from the performer lines (lords, dancers, pipers, drummers: about $33.6k, roughly 65%), which follow wages, plus the rings and partridge.

What different growth rates would give, applied to $51,476.12:
| Change | 2026 total |
|---|---|
| 0% | $51,476 (below the question's range floor) |
| +1% | $51,991 |
| +2% | $52,506 |
| +3% | $53,020 |
| +4.5% | $53,793 |
| +6% | $54,565 |
| +10% | $56,624 |

- Seasonality: none applies. It is a single annual reading.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on the 2026 Christmas Price Index. None of the pre-collected markets match the question. The closest related ones are about the DXY, paper PPI and FX.
- I found no expert or media forecast of the 2026 figure.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Late November 2026, likely the week of Nov 23 (Thanksgiving week), going by 2025's Nov 24 date: PNC releases the 2026 index. This is not confirmed.
- Things that could move the number:
  - retail gold ring prices, with spot gold down year over year
  - performer wage and fee changes, which are the biggest weight
  - swan pricing, flat for years but a big single line: the 2022 swan change drove much of that year's +10.5%
  - any method change; PNC changed its method in 1995, 2015 and 2020
- No weather dependence.

No 2026 PNC Christmas Price Index has been published yet. The latest official figure is $51,476.12, for 2025. Last year PNC released the index on November 24, 2025, so this year's number will most likely come out between November 23 and December 1, which is before the question resolves.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2025-11-24: PNC's index page still shows the 2025 edition: a total of **$51,476.12**, up 4.5% from $49,263.47 in 2024. The "True Cost" (all 364 gifts) is $218,542.98 (+4.4%), and the core index, which leaves out the swans, is $38,351.12 (+6.1%). [PNC](https://www.pnc.com/en/about-pnc/topics/pnc-christmas-price-index.html)
- 2025 prices by item:
  - Seven swans: $13,125, unchanged.
  - Leaping lords: $16,836.14 (+8.1%).
  - Dancing ladies: $8,856.88 (+3.5%).
  - Drummers: $4,106.08 (+2.2%).
  - Pipers: $3,797.48 (+2.2%).
  - Five gold rings: $1,649.90 (+32.5%).
  - Geese: $930 (+3.3%).
  - Turtle doves: $750, unchanged.

  - Partridge in a pear tree: $420.18 (+13.5%).
  - French hens: $346.50, unchanged.
  - Maids a-milking: $58, unchanged. [PNC](https://www.pnc.com/en/about-pnc/topics/pnc-christmas-price-index.html)
- The 2025 release is dated 2025-11-24. [PNC mediaroom](https://pnc.mediaroom.com/2025-11-24-PNCs-2025-Christmas-Price-Index-R-Holiday-Cheer-Comes-at-a-Premium)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-11-12: Nothing settles the question yet. No 2026 figure turned up in either search mode (standard or extended). [search results incl. businessjournaldaily](https://businessjournaldaily.com/pncs-christmas-price-index-rises-4-5/)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-11-10: October CPI rose 0.4% from September, above the 0.3% expected. [Nikkei](https://www.nikkei.com/article/DGXZQOFL110100R11C26A1000000/)
  - FactSet's consensus before the release was 4.0% year over year, with core at 2.8%.
  - September CPI was 3.7% year over year. [FactSet](https://insight.factset.com/consumer-price-index-cpi-for-october-2026-is-projected-to-rise-4.0-year-over-year?hs_amp=true)
  - I did not confirm the actual October year-over-year figure.
- 2026-11-09: Gold was about $4,119/oz. It had touched a one-year low of $3,869.85 on October 30, and its record was about $5,595 to $5,608 in late January 2026. [investingnews](https://investingnews.com/gold-rebounds-after-jobs-data/), [tradingeconomics](https://tradingeconomics.com/commodity/gold?refid=refid)
  - In late November 2025, when the 2025 index was priced, gold was roughly $4,000 to $4,100. So gold is about flat year over year, unlike the 45% rise behind 2025's +32.5% on the rings.
  - The rings are only about 3% of the total, so gold matters little either way.
- 2025-11-24: PNC's Agati said 2026 "will reveal whether inflation finally cools or remains the lump of coal." [kpcnews](https://www.kpcnews.com/heraldrepublican/article_8a040e01-085f-558b-bea4-7d808de9d692.html)
- Structure of the index: the four performer groups (lords, ladies, pipers, drummers) together are about $33.6k, roughly 65% of the total, and they track wages and fees. The swans add another 25%, $13,125, and have been unchanged recently.
- Maids are priced at 8 × the $7.25 federal minimum wage. I am not aware of any federal change, so that item should stay at $58.

## 4. Base rates
- Annual totals and changes: [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christmas_Price_Index)

| Year | Total (USD) | Change |
|---|---|---|
| 2018 | $38,926.03 | +11.2% |
| 2019 | $38,993.59 | +0.17% |
| 2020 | $16,168.14 | pandemic, performers dropped |
| 2021 | $41,205.58 | +5.7% vs 2019 |
| 2022 | $45,523.27 | +10.5% |
| 2023 | $46,729.86 | +2.7% |
| 2024 | $49,263.47 | +5.4% |
| 2025 | $51,476.12 | +4.5% |

- Since 2021, annual changes have run between +2.7% and +10.5%, around a median of about 5%. Earlier years (2014 to 2017, 2019) had several changes under 1%.
- Applying past changes to $51,476:

| Change applied | Implied 2026 total |
|---|---|
| +0% | $51,476 |
| +2.7% | about $52,866 |
| +4.5% | about $53,792 |
| +5.4% | about $54,256 |
| +10.5% | about $56,881 |

- The question's range starts at $52,000, which equals about +1.0%.
- Seasonality: the index is published once a year, so no within-season path applies.
- Release timing:
  - 2025: November 24.
  - 2013: around December 2.
  - 2014: around December 1. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Christmas_Price_Index)

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi, Manifold or Metaculus market on the PNC index.
- None of the Kalshi or Polymarket markets supplied with the question (paper PPI, foreign exchange, silver, DXY and others) relates to this question.
- I found no published expert estimate of the 2026 total.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- About 2026-11-23 to 2026-12-01: PNC's 43rd annual release is likely, going by the 2025 Thanksgiving-week timing. It will resolve the question.
- Inputs to watch:
  - Swans: the biggest single item, often unchanged, but historically the most volatile.
  - Ballet and union performer rates: the lords alone are 33% of the total.
  - Retail prices for gold rings and birds.
- Weather does not affect the outcome.

forecasts.reasoning:
(a) **Time left:** About 2 to 3 weeks. The PNC release is expected around Thanksgiving week in late November 2026. Forecasts close today, November 12, 2026.

(b) **Latest known value:** $51,476.12 for 2025, released November 24, 2025, and still shown on the PNC page as of November 12, 2026. The 2025 item prices on the page sum exactly to this total.

(c) **If nothing changed:** $51,476. Swans ($13,125) have been flat for several years, so a fully flat year is the "nothing changed" case, though a complete freeze is rare.

(d) **If the trend continued:** The 2022-2025 average gain is about 5.8%, and the last two years were +5.4% and +4.5%.
- The performer lines (about 65% of the total) follow wage growth of roughly 3.5 to 5%.
- Gold rings are a small line. Spot gold is down about 6% year over year, but retail prices lag and gold spiked earlier in 2026, so this line is likely mixed.
- Swans are probably flat again.
- CPI looks to be running around 3%.
